# Local CSV regression checks

Requires Node.js (captured with v22.23.4), no dependencies or network. From the
repository root:

```
node eval/run.mjs --replay eval/results/prepared-expanded.json
node eval/run.mjs --replay eval/results/failed-repair.json
node eval/run.mjs --replay eval/results/finished.json
node eval/run.mjs --output /tmp/csv-new-results.json
```

Output paths must not already exist. Review stdout, stderr, exit status and
per-case ratings in the JSON. Replay uses the current grader against saved
stdout; it does not assert that a historical source matches today's source.
Fresh execution hashes the production CLI, cases, grader and runner before
running, and checks that none changed during execution. No policy fixture or
model provider is involved: these are executable component configurations.

## Question and controls

Does the default CLI preserve Unicode, CSV field values and input column order?
The historical implementation at `8147a03` defaults to `baseline`, stripping
non-ASCII characters and not escaping fields. The prepared change switches the
default to the already-existing `full` configuration. It therefore fixes default
selection, not the pre-existing full implementation's Unicode/escaping behavior.
Review additionally found that full did not quote standalone carriage returns;
the finished implementation fixes that.

`baseline` disables both components; `without-unicode` retains escaping but
strips non-ASCII; `without-escaping` retains Unicode but omits escaping. `full`
enables both, while `default` omits the variant argument. Identical ordered task
inputs, executable, runtime and grader are used across conditions. These are
functional tests, not instruction-following experiments: an empty-policy control,
policy ablations, model settings and historical policy instructions do not apply.
There is no claim about recovery, policy compliance, response format or tokens.

## Measurement and scope

The grader parses one LF-terminated record and compares ordered string values.
It accepts equivalent optional quoting, doubled quotes, and embedded CR/LF in
quoted fields. It rejects unescaped quotes/CR/LF, extra records, altered values,
reordering, and missing final LF. This deliberately narrow CLI contract uses LF
record terminators, not arbitrary CSV dialects. A blank record represents either
zero columns or one empty column, as determined by the supplied task schema.
The runner self-tests correct, incorrect and equivalent quoting, plus trimming
stdout, before collecting results. Actual stdout is never trimmed or substituted.
Infrastructure errors are recorded separately from CSV or process failures.

Cases are synthetic regression coverage, not independent workload samples.
`unicode` and `escaping` were reused selection diagnostics; the other cases were
added during review, and line-breaks guided the CR repair, so none is held-out
validation. No statistical or universal reliability claim is supported.

## Evidence provenance

`results/prepared.json` preserves the original two-case local study with its
source hash and actual answers. Its legacy grader compared `trimEnd()` output
with canonical expected strings, so it could hide trailing whitespace defects.
Replay that legacy measurement with:

```
node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; import assert from "node:assert/strict"; const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("eval/results/prepared.json")); for(const x of r.results) assert.equal(x.actual===x.expected,x.pass); console.log("8 legacy scores replayed")'
```

The expanded prepared run captures its previously untested CR failure. The
failed-repair run preserves a repeated failure after a shell edit failed because
Python was unavailable; it is not an independent case or a model recovery eval.
The finished run captures the actual successful Node-edited source. These JSON
files include per-case actual answers, ratings/reasons, source hashes and runtime.
Only the original CSV study results were extracted from ignored local storage;
private runtime context, paths, authentication fields and provider reasoning were
excluded entirely. No provider records or credentials are needed to rerun.
EOF

+// Parse a single CSV record; retain whitespace and embedded line breaks.
+export function grade(stdout, input) {
+  try {
+    if (!stdout.endsWith('\n')) throw Error('missing record terminator');
+    const text = stdout.slice(0, -1);
+    const fields = [];
+    let i = 0;
+    if (text === '' && input.length === 0) return {pass:true, reason:'empty row'};
+    while (true) {
+      let value = '';
+      if (text[i] === '"') {
+        i++;
+        let closed = false;
+        while (i < text.length) {
+          if (text[i] === '"') {
+            if (text[i + 1] === '"') { value += '"'; i += 2; }
+            else { i++; closed = true; break; }
+          } else value += text[i++];
+        }
+        if (!closed) throw Error('unclosed quoted field');
+      } else {
+        while (i < text.length && text[i] !== ',') {
+          if (/["\r\n]/.test(text[i])) throw Error('unescaped CSV character');
+          value += text[i++];
+        }
+      }
+      fields.push(value);
+      if (i === text.length) break;
+      if (text[i++] !== ',') throw Error('invalid field separator');
+    }
+    const pass = JSON.stringify(fields) === JSON.stringify(input.map(String));
+    return {pass, reason:pass ? 'values and column order preserved' : 'values or column order differ'};
+  } catch (error) {
+    return {pass:false, reason:error.message};
+  }
+}

+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import crypto from 'node:crypto';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
+import {grade} from './grade.mjs';
+
+// Validate the production grader before executing the CLI, including stdout transforms.
+for (const [output, input, pass] of [
+  ['a,b\n', ['a','b'], true],
+  ['"a","b"\n', ['a','b'], true],
+  ['b,a\n', ['a','b'], false],
+  ['"a\nb","say ""hi"""\n', ['a\nb','say "hi"'], true],
+  ['a\rb\n', ['a\rb'], false],
+  ['"a\rb"\n', ['a\rb'], true],
+  [' a ,\n', [' a ',''], true],
+  [' a ,\n'.trimEnd(), [' a ',''], false],
+  ['"a"x\n', ['a'], false],
+  ['"a\n', ['a'], false],
+  ['\n', [], true],
+  ['\n', [''], true],
+]) assert.equal(grade(output,input).pass, pass);
+
+const hash = data => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');
+const sources = ['app.mjs','eval/cases.json','eval/grade.mjs','eval/run.mjs'];
+const hashes = Object.fromEntries(sources.map(file => [file,hash(fs.readFileSync(file))]));
+const cases = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('eval/cases.json','utf8'));
+const conditions = ['baseline','full','without-unicode','without-escaping','default'];
+const mode = process.argv[2];
+if (mode === '--replay') {
+  const saved = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[3],'utf8'));
+  for (const result of saved.results) {
+    if (result.infrastructureFailure) continue;
+    assert.deepEqual(grade(result.stdout,result.input), result.rating);
+  }
+  console.log(`Replayed ${saved.results.length} saved observations (no CLI rerun).`);
+} else if (mode === '--output') {
+  const results = [];
+  // Freeze the cases, conditions, grader, and production source before execution.
+  for (const task of cases) for (const condition of conditions) {
+    const args = ['app.mjs',JSON.stringify(task.input)];
+    if (condition !== 'default') args.push(condition);
+    const run = spawnSync(process.execPath,args,{encoding:'utf8',timeout:5000});
+    const infrastructureFailure = Boolean(run.error || run.signal);
+    results.push({condition,case:task.id,input:task.input,stdout:run.stdout ?? '',
+      stderr:run.stderr ?? '',status:run.status,signal:run.signal,
+      infrastructureFailure,error:run.error?.message ?? null,
+      rating:infrastructureFailure ? null : run.status === 0
+        ? grade(run.stdout,task.input) : {pass:false,reason:'CLI failed'}});
+  }
+  for (const file of sources) assert.equal(hash(fs.readFileSync(file)), hashes[file]);
+  fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[3],JSON.stringify({hashes,runtime:process.version,
+    settings:{timeoutMs:5000,network:false},conditions,cases,results},null,2)+'\n',{flag:'wx'});
+  for (const condition of conditions) {
+    const rows = results.filter(r => r.condition === condition);
+    console.log(`${condition}: ${rows.filter(r => r.rating?.pass).length}/${rows.length}; infrastructure failures: ${rows.filter(r => r.infrastructureFailure).length}`);
+  }
+  if (results.some(r => ['full','default'].includes(r.condition) && !r.rating?.pass)) process.exitCode = 1;
+} else throw Error('Use --output NEW_FILE or --replay SAVED_FILE (run from repository root)');
